About Flight Party

Flight Party is JoyFlock's flagship multiplayer board game: four colours of planes leave the hangar on a six, travel the track, hop on matching squares and send opponents back to base. The rules stay classic; the board, dice and planes are rebuilt from scratch.

Rooms take 2–4 players. Invite friends, quick-match strangers or fill seats with an easy computer pilot. If someone leaves, the seat waits for a reconnect before a bot takes over — one click hands it back.

How to play

  1. Roll a six to launch a plane from the hangar, and roll again.
  2. Move along your own track; landing on your own colour hops to the next one, and sharing a square with your own plane stacks them.
  3. Landing on an opponent sends their plane back to base. First to fly every plane home wins.

Frequently asked questions

Does a dropped player lose the match?
No. The room waits 30 seconds, then an easy bot plays at its own pace. Reconnecting or simply moving the mouse hands the seat straight back.
How many players can join?
Rooms take 2–4 players; empty seats can be filled by computer pilots.
Do I need an account to play online?
No. Guests can join a room directly; an account only saves Joy Coins, stats and cosmetics.
